name: IBF Financial Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: IBF Financial Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual and corporate clients primarily in Taiwan. The company engages in the brokerage and proprietary trading of short-term bills and bonds; underwriting, certification, signing, and guarantee of commercial promissory notes; trading and underwriting securities, such as commercial papers and bonds; and consignment trading of securities.
